__comment: Translator context notes (spec §30.2). Keys mirror en.json; values are short hints shown to translators in the Weblate editor. This file is NOT rendered in the UI. When a key in en.json has no matching entry here, Weblate falls back to the English source as sole context.
app.title: Product name — never translate.
nav.feed: Top-level nav label — keep short (≤ 10 chars). 'Feed' as in 'timeline', not 'food'.
nav.stickies: 'Sticky notes' on a shared pinboard. Keep short (≤ 10 chars).
spaces.create: Button label that opens the new-space wizard.
spaces.space_title: Fallback title shown when a space has no name set. Used very rarely.
pairing.enter_code: 6-digit SAS verification code after scanning the QR. Do not change the digit count.
pairing.show_qr: Shown above the QR code the peer is supposed to scan.
pairing.waiting: Shown in a spinner while waiting for the remote side to scan the QR.
calls.ringing: Caller-side label while the callee's device is ringing.
event.span.starts: Badge on the first day of a multi-day event in the day-by-day agenda. Very short (≤ 8 chars) — it sits in a pill next to the time.
event.span.ends: Badge on the last day of a multi-day event. Very short (≤ 8 chars).
event.span.day_of: Badge on the middle days of a multi-day event. {n} = this day's number, {total} = length of the whole event in days. Keep short — 'D2/3' is fine where the language has no compact wording.
event.span.from: Time hint on the first day of a multi-day event — the event starts at {time} and runs past midnight. Lowercase; it follows the date range on the same line.
event.span.until: Time hint on the last day of a multi-day event — it ends at {time}. Lowercase; follows the date range on the same line.
event.span.all_day: Time hint on a day a multi-day event covers from midnight to midnight. Lowercase; follows the date range on the same line.
event.span.aria: Screen-reader-only summary of where a row sits in a multi-day event. {range} is an already-formatted date range (e.g. '1–3 May').
presence.state.home: Presence value: physically at home (within the configured radius).
presence.state.away: Presence value: briefly away but still 'around' (e.g. gym, shops).
presence.state.not_home: Presence value: travelling, at work, etc.
presence.dnd: 'Do Not Disturb' — mutes push notifications. Keep pithy.
common.error: Generic error label, surfaced in toasts and inline.
common.retry: Button that re-triggers the failed operation.
common.not_now: 'Dismiss for now' — used in soft-promotion banners.
search.scope.post: Search filter: household feed posts (not space posts).
search.scope.space_post: Search filter: posts inside any space the user is a member of.
gfs.publish: 'Publish' a space to the Global Federation Server directory so strangers on the public internet can discover it.
gfs.unpublish: Opposite of publish — take the space back off the public directory.
space.federation: Settings-tab label inside a space — controls GFS publication + cross-household sharing.
space.retention_keep_legend: Space settings → Retention. Heading over checkboxes of post kinds that are never auto-deleted.
space.retention_keep_schedule: A 'schedule' post = a poll to find a date/time that suits everyone (Doodle-style).
space.retention_keep_event: The feed card auto-created for a calendar event (with RSVP buttons) — not the calendar entry itself.
dms.mute.menu_title: Heading of the menu that silences one chat (DM or group) for a while.
dms.mute.1h: Mute length option in the chat's mute menu.
dms.mute.8h: Mute length option in the chat's mute menu.
dms.mute.1w: Mute length option in the chat's mute menu.
dms.mute.forever: Mute length option: stays muted until the user unmutes it.
dms.mute.unmute: Button that turns a muted chat's notifications back on.
dms.mute.muted_until: Status of a muted chat. {time} is a clock time or a short date + time.
dms.mute.muted_forever: Status of a chat muted with no end time.
dms.mute.unmute_hint: Tooltip / screen-reader label of the bell-slash button. {state} is the muted status line.
dms.mute.section: Section heading in the group info dialog.
dms.mute.on: Shown in the group info dialog when the chat isn't muted.
dms.mute.error: Toast when the mute change failed (network / server).
dms.notif.heading: Group chat: heading above the two notification levels (All messages / Only @mentions).
dms.notif.all: Group chat notification level: every message notifies.
dms.notif.mentions: Group chat notification level: only messages that @mention you notify. Keep the @.
dms.notif.mentions_hint: Tooltip / screen-reader label of the thread header bell when the level is Only @mentions.
dms.notif.toast_all: Toast after switching a group back to All messages.
dms.notif.toast_mentions: Toast after switching a group to Only @mentions.
dms.mute.on_mentions: Group info Notifications section, not muted, level Only @mentions.
location.share_title: Title of the location picker dialog (chat and feed composer).
location.pick_on_map: Button: choose a place by tapping a map instead of using GPS.
location.precision_note: Privacy reassurance: coordinates are rounded to 4 decimals (~11 m).
location.accuracy: Shown under a shared pin; {m} is a coarse accuracy radius in metres.
dms.attach.menu: Paperclip button in the chat composer that opens the attach menu.
dms.location.send_failed: Toast; {error} is a technical error message.
connection.unreachable: Banner shown when the browser is online but the Social Home server can't be reached; the app keeps retrying in the background.
connection.retry: Button in the unreachable banner — reconnects immediately instead of waiting.
connection.reconnected: Short toast after the connection comes back.
shortcuts.menu_entry: Sidebar entry that opens the keyboard-shortcuts help dialog.
shortcuts.typing_note: Footnote in the shortcuts dialog: '/', 'n' and '?' do nothing while the cursor is in a text field.
theme.save_failed: Toast after a refused theme save. {error} = the server's reason (English, e.g. 'font_family must be one of: …').
theme.font.mono: Name of a monospace font style. Keep short.
theme.layout.magazine: Post layout name: roomy, reading-oriented cards. Keep short.
theme.font.inherit: Space theme font option: no font override, the space uses the household's font.
theme.corner_radius: Slider label. {px} = a number of pixels, 0–24.
space.proposal.owner_body: Approval banner sentence. {action} = one of the space.proposal.action.* / role.* / fwd.* phrases, already in the form that fits here (e.g. German zu-infinitive). Translate those phrases to read naturally inside this sentence.
space.proposal.admin_body: Same as space.proposal.owner_body; a majority of the space's admins must approve.
space.proposal.requested_by: {name} = the requester's display name, or space.proposal.requester_unknown.
space.proposal.requester_unknown: Fallback for {name} in space.proposal.requested_by when the requester's name isn't known.
space.proposal.role.moderator: Fills {action} in space.proposal.owner_body. {name} = a member's display name, or space.proposal.someone.
space.proposal.fwd.ban: Fills {action} in space.proposal.owner_body — like the other space.proposal.fwd.* / action.* phrases.
space.private_gfs.intro: One sentence above the private-space GFS switch introducing the term. Keep 'GFS' untranslated; the '(Global Federation Server)' expansion may stay in English.
space.followers.allow: Checkbox on a public space: lets anyone follow (read) it. 'Followers' read along but cannot post.
space.private_gfs.toggle: Owner-only switch on a private space. 'GFS' = the Global Federation Server; keep 'GFS' untranslated as a product name. The expansion is spelled out once in space.private_gfs.intro just above.
space.private_gfs.on: Heading over the explanation of the switch's ON state. Very short.
space.private_gfs.off: Heading over the explanation of the switch's OFF state. Very short.
invite.via.gfs: Invite link type: redeemed through the GFS (Global Federation Server), so households that never paired can join. Keep 'GFS' untranslated.
invite.via.internal: Invite link type shown to users as 'Local link': only households already connected (directly or through other households) can use it. Translate 'local' naturally; the API value stays 'internal'.
invite.via.badge_gfs: Small badge on an invite link row. Keep short.
invite.via.badge_internal: Small badge on an invite link row ('Local'). Keep short.
invite.via.badge_legacy: Small badge on a pre-existing invite link row. Keep short.
invite.via.badge_legacy_hint: Tooltip on the earlier-link badge: explains it still works and that using it turns the GFS on.
